move: band slashes across, quote words stamp in alternating, highlight word squashes
how: A grayscale photo drifts from scale 1.15 xPercent 2 to 1.02 / -2 linearly while an SVG athlete slides in from x:300 with expo.out and floats. A lime band scaleX 0→1 with expo.inOut at 0.06D and wipes out from the right at 0.17D; a quote mark pops with back.out(2.5). Five quote rows rise out of masks (yPercent 115→0, expo.out, stagger 0.09) while each row also slides in from alternating ±8% xPercent; the highlighted word settles from scaleX 1.15 / scaleY 0.85 with elastic.out(1,0.4). A rule draws and the attribution rises. From 0.84D words shove up with expo.in, attribution and rule retract, the mark shrinks with back.in(2) and the athlete exits right.
adapt: Replace the photo, the five quote rows (mark one .hi), the attribution and the accent colour; swap the athlete SVG for a cut-out image. Keep the 0.09 stagger, the band timing and the elastic squash.
port: mount(el, shot) builds .bg, .athlete, .shade, .band, .mark, .quote rows, .rule and .who; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with offsets as fractions of D (band 0.3/5, words 0.75/5, exit 4.2/5). Scope selectors to el.
caveats: grayscale/contrast filter on a full-frame background
from() tweens need immediateRender:false when rebuilt
